# MetaStrip

> Free browser tool to inspect and remove supported metadata from images, documents, audio and video. Files are processed locally using Web Workers; file contents and extracted metadata are not uploaded to MetaStrip.

## Main pages
- [Web tool](https://metastrip.ai/): inspect files, clean supported metadata, review the output, download individual files or a ZIP.
- [Documentation and format limits](https://metastrip.ai/docs#browser-limits): actual coverage and limitations.
- [CLI and MCP setup](https://metastrip.ai/docs): local developer workflows.
- [Privacy](https://metastrip.ai/privacy): analytics, hosting and optional external map links.
- [Source code](https://github.com/ICXCNIKAanon/metastrip): MIT-licensed source.
- [Metadata guide](https://metastrip.ai/blog/what-is-metadata): background information.

## Browser formats
JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, SVG, PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, EPUB, MP3, WAV, FLAC, M4A, MP4, MOV, AVI, MKV/WebM. Raw AAC is not supported. HEIC/AVIF image-item cleaning is currently rejected to avoid corrupting image structure. Limits: 50 files, 500 MB total per batch.

## What results mean
- Inspection and removal coverage vary by format. Detailed inspection is limited for GIF, SVG, HEIC/HEIF, AVIF, EPUB and MKV/WebM.
- Image and media cleaning does not recompress the encoded media. Rendering metadata can affect display. Review the downloaded copy.
- Color profiles are preserved by default for JPEG, PNG and WebP.
- A zero detected-risk score is not a guarantee of anonymity. Visible contents, embedded files and unsupported metadata may still identify someone.
- PDF processing is limited to supported readable fields and plain XMP packets. It is not document redaction.
- File processing is local. Basic website analytics remain enabled. Opening an external map link sends its coordinates to the selected provider.
- The web tool is free and requires no account. Do not describe the coming-soon hosted API as an available paid service.

## Developer tools
Packages: @metastrip/core, @metastrip/cli, @metastrip/mcp-server, @metastrip/hooks. See the documentation for installation and package-specific support. Browser extensions cannot reliably intercept proprietary upload workflows such as Gmail, Slack or Discord; clean files before uploading there.

## Common questions

### Are files uploaded? No. Processing uses local file buffers in browser workers.

### Is metadata cleaning redaction? No. Visible content and unsupported hidden fields can remain.

### Can I batch clean files? Yes. Successful files can be downloaded together as a ZIP.
